facts.business: Impex Ferro Tech Limited manufactures ferro alloys, which are critical additives in iron and steel production, operating a plant at Kalyaneshwari, West Bengal.

auditor.name: M/s V.K.Tulsyan & Co. LLP, Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Economic and political conditions in India
New regulations and government policies impacting business
Deteriorated financial condition making compliance difficult
Non-appointment of Whole-time Company Secretary and CFO after resignation
No active committee members since May 2, 2024
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties as per Accounting Standard 18 are disclosed in the relevant Schedule of Notes to Annual Accounts. The Independent Statutory Auditors' Audit Report does not contain any adverse observations on related party transactions.
